artifacts.summary: Research for app:presheaf-dictionary's Reflection clause: the recovered paper text, the existing FrameOver.rev converse frame and the layering promotion needed to consume it, and the full clause verified by a compiled choice-free probe.

user_decision.question: Consuming the repository's existing converse frame requires promoting the frame-level reversal block out of FormalSystem/OpenLanguage/OpenReversal.lean down into FormalSystem/Semantics/TaskFrame.lean, because a compiled probe shows that importing OpenReversal into the Presheaf cluster trips that cluster's assert_not_exists ProofSystem.Axiom guard. That widens this task's declared file_scope from one module to three. Accept the widening, or keep the single-module scope and define a second converse frame locally?
options: Promote the frame-level reversal block into Semantics/TaskFrame.lean and widen file_scope to include it and OpenReversal.lean, so the tree keeps exactly one converse frame
Keep file_scope at the single Reflection.lean module and define a local converse frame there, recording in the docstring why a second one was needed
user_decision.recommended: Promote the frame-level reversal block into Semantics/TaskFrame.lean and widen file_scope to include it and OpenReversal.lean, so the tree keeps exactly one converse frame
